UNIQUE(deduplicationKey) is enforced in persistent storage.
findOrCreatePending and claimForDispatch must be atomic.
A dispatch lease prevents concurrent worker sends.
Use provider-side idempotency keys when supported;
otherwise a crash after sending can still cause duplicates.
Record applied filters, requesting user and generatedAt
for each export, including re-generated versions.
Audit all exports and alert on mass-export attempts.
Each attachment belongs to exactly one parent:
either a Customer or an Invoice, not both.
Store file metadata and an opaque storage key only;
reject malicious uploads before storing files (NFR-5.5).
Access requires authorization to the parent record.
Reminder eligibility is based on the invoice's
unpaid, unresolved balance, not customer status.
Cancellation must not stop historical debt reminders.
Day-3 and day-5 offsets are calendar days;
Persistent record of audited domain changes.
Controller lifelines in DS-BASE are generic placeholders;
they do not require a concrete ApplicationController class.
